remedies.title: Ginger-Tulsi Kadha for Cold & Cough
remedies.description: A traditional warming herbal decoction designed to balance Vata and Kapha, soothe throat irritation, and boost respiratory immunity.
remedies.preparation:
1. Boil water in a pan.
2. Add the grated ginger, Tulsi leaves, and crushed black pepper.
3. Reduce the heat and simmer until the liquid is halved (approx. 10-12 mins).
4. Strain the liquid and let it cool down to warm/lukewarm.
5. Stir in the honey (never add honey to boiling liquid as Ayurveda considers heated honey toxic).
remedies.dosage: Drink 1/2 cup (warm) twice daily after meals.
warnings: Avoid if you have active acid reflux or bleeding disorders (Pitta imbalance).
Do not boil honey directly.

remedies.title: Golden Milk (Haldi Doodh) for Immunity & Pain
remedies.description: A soothing, warm wellness drink packed with anti-inflammatory properties, perfect for pacifying Vata and Pitta doshas while strengthening joints and immunity.
ingredients: Crushed Black Pepper - a tiny pinch (enhances turmeric absorption)
Cardamom Powder - a pinch (for flavour and Vata pacification)
remedies.preparation:
1. Heat milk in a saucepan on medium heat.
2. Stir in turmeric powder, black pepper, and cardamom powder.
3. Bring to a gentle boil, then simmer on low heat for 5 minutes.
4. Pour into a cup, let it cool slightly, and sweeten with honey or maple syrup.
remedies.dosage: Drink 1 cup warm before bedtime.
warnings: Turmeric in medicinal doses is warming; reduce usage if experiencing extreme body heat or Pitta flare-ups.
Pregnant women should consult a practitioner before taking high doses.

remedies.title: Cumin-Coriander-Fennel (CCF) Tea for Digestion
remedies.description: A highly revered Ayurvedic blend known as CCF Tea. It balances all three doshas (Tridoshic), enlivens Agni (digestive fire) without overheating, and removes Ama (toxins).
benefits: Cools hot flashes or stomach acidity
remedies.preparation:
1. Combine water and the seeds (cumin, coriander, fennel) in a small pot.
2. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 5-10 minutes.
3. Strain and pour into a thermos to sip throughout the day, or enjoy fresh.
remedies.dosage: Sip warm throughout the day, particularly 15-30 minutes before or after meals.
warnings: Generally extremely safe for everyone.
If pregnant, consult your doctor prior to excessive intake of herbal teas.

remedies.title: Ashwagandha Latte for Stress & Sleep
remedies.description: An adaptogenic evening brew designed to ground a hyperactive nervous system, calm Vata dosha, and invite restful, restorative sleep.
ingredients: Nutmeg Powder - a tiny pinch (natural sedative in Ayurveda)
remedies.preparation:
1. Heat the milk in a pot until warm.
2. Whisk in the Ashwagandha powder, nutmeg powder, and ghee.
3. Warm on low heat for 3-4 minutes to activate the herbs.
4. Pour into a mug, let cool slightly, and stir in your sweetener.
remedies.dosage: Drink warm 45 minutes before sleeping.
warnings: Not recommended during active fever or severe congestion (Ama overload).
Consult an Ayurvedic doctor if pregnant.

remedies.title: Triphala Gentle Detox Cleanser
remedies.description: A classic formula combining three native fruits: Amalaki, Bibhitaki, and Haritaki. It is the premier formula for colon health, digestive regularity, and tissue rejuvenation.
benefits: Rich in Vitamin C and antioxidants
remedies.preparation:
1. Add Triphala powder to a cup of warm water.
2. Stir well and let it sit for 2-3 minutes to dissolve.
remedies.dosage: Drink before bedtime, at least 1-2 hours after your final meal.
warnings: Do not use during active diarrhea or dysentery.
Discontinue if it causes stomach cramps.

remedies.title: Aloe Vera & Mint Cooler for Acidity & Pitta
remedies.description: A cooling, soothing elixir formulated to calm elevated Pitta dosha, cool stomach acid, heal skin rashes, and relieve heart burn.
ingredients: Coconut Water or Pure Water - 1 cup
remedies.preparation:
1. Blend fresh mint leaves with aloe vera juice and lemon juice.
2. Strain if desired, then stir into coconut water.
3. Add a pinch of fennel powder for extra digestive cooling.
remedies.dosage: Drink on an empty stomach in the morning or 30 mins before lunch.
warnings: Avoid if you have cold, cough, or strong Kapha accumulation.
Do not consume Aloe Vera latex; only use pure edible inner leaf juice.

remedies.title: Shallaki (Boswellia) & Nirgundi Decoction for Knee Pain & Arthritis
remedies.description: A potent anti-inflammatory herbal decoction balancing Vata dosha, reducing knee joint stiffness, preserving cartilage, and alleviating morning joint pain.
remedies.preparation:
1. Boil 2 cups of water with Shallaki, Nirgundi, and crushed ginger in a pot.
2. Simmer on medium heat until reduced to 1 cup.
3. Strain and let cool until pleasantly warm before sipping.
remedies.dosage: Drink 1/2 cup warm twice daily after meals.
warnings: Avoid taking on an empty stomach if you have severe acid reflux.
Pregnant women should consult an Ayurvedic physician prior to use.

remedies.title: Mahanarayana & Warm Sesame Oil Poultice for Knee Stiffness
remedies.description: A traditional Ayurvedic external Janu Basti compress using warm sesame and Mahanarayana oil to deeply lubricate knee joints and ease chronic pain.
ingredients: Mahanarayana Oil (or Pure Sesame Oil) - 4 tablespoons
remedies.preparation:
1. Gently warm the Mahanarayana oil in a bowl over a water bath.
2. Add a tiny pinch of camphor.
3. Dip a clean cotton cloth into the warm oil and place over the knee joint for 15-20 minutes.
remedies.dosage: Apply warm compress once daily in the evening or after bath.
warnings: Ensure the oil is pleasantly warm, not hot, to prevent skin burns.
Do not apply on open cuts or inflamed skin breaks.

remedies.title: Sunthi (Dry Ginger) & Castor Oil Paste for Inflammatory Knee Swelling
remedies.description: A soothing topical ginger-castor paste (Lepa) formulated to draw out fluid accumulation, reduce joint swelling (Ama Vata), and restore knee flex.
remedies.preparation:
1. Mix dry ginger powder with castor oil and a splash of warm water to form a smooth paste.
2. Apply evenly over the affected knee joint.
3. Cover loosely with a cloth for 30 minutes, then wash with warm water.
remedies.dosage: Apply topically once daily for 5-7 days during swelling.
warnings: Perform a small patch test on skin first.
Discontinue if redness or skin irritation occurs.

remedies.title: Fenugreek (Methi) & Flaxseed Porridge for Osteoarthritis & Lubrication
remedies.description: A warm dietary porridge rich in Omega-3 fatty acids and phyto-nutrients that nourishes Synovial fluid (Shleshaka Kapha) and protects joint movement.
remedies.preparation:
1. Boil soaked fenugreek seeds and flaxseed meal in milk for 8 minutes.
2. Sweeten with natural jaggery and serve warm.
remedies.dosage: Consume 1 bowl warm in the morning as breakfast support.
warnings: Fenugreek is slightly warming; reduce dose if experiencing nosebleeds or body heat.

remedies.title: Dashamoola Kashayam for Lower Back & Sciatica Nerve Pain
remedies.description: The famous ten-root classic Ayurvedic decoction (Dashamoola) that specifically targets spinal stiffness, sciatica, lower back strain, and nerve pain.
remedies.preparation:
1. Combine Dashamoola powder and ginger in 2 cups of water.
2. Boil on medium heat until reduced to 1/2 cup.
3. Strain and drink warm.
remedies.dosage: Drink 1/2 cup warm in the morning or bedtime.
warnings: Consult an Ayurvedic doctor if taking prescribed blood thinners.

remedies.title: Hadjod (Bone Setter) & Turmeric Milk for Bone Density & Ligament Repair
remedies.description: Hadjod (Cissus quadrangularis) is Ayurveda's legendary bone-building herb. Paired with turmeric, it accelerates ligament recovery and fortifies knee bone density.
ingredients: Cow Milk or Sesame Milk - 1 cup
remedies.preparation:
1. Whisk Hadjod and turmeric powder into warm milk.
2. Simmer gently for 3 minutes.
3. Let cool to lukewarm and stir in raw honey.
remedies.dosage: Drink 1 cup warm once daily after dinner.
warnings: Do not exceed recommended dosage.
Not advised for children without physician guidance.

remedies.title: Guggulu & Ajwain Warm Herbal Compress for Morning Joint Stiffness
remedies.description: A warming herbal steam compress (Potali Sweda) using Carom seeds (Ajwain) and Guggulu to melt morning stiffness and improve joint flexion.
remedies.preparation:
1. Dry roast Ajwain seeds, rock salt, and garlic on a pan until fragrant.
2. Tie tightly into a cotton pouch (Potali).
3. Warm the pouch on a dry pan and gently press onto the stiff knee.
remedies.dosage: Apply warm Potali compress for 10-15 minutes twice daily.
warnings: Test temperature on forearm before applying to avoid heat discomfort.

remedies.title: Punarnava & Giloy Decoction for Gout & High Uric Acid Joint Pain
remedies.description: A purifying Ayurvedic herbal remedy that promotes kidney uric acid excretion, reduces gout flare-ups, and relieves swelling in big toes and knees.
benefits: Flushes excess uric acid from blood
Relieves gout toe & knee joint pain
remedies.preparation:
1. Boil Punarnava, Giloy, and coriander seeds in 2 cups of water.
2. Reduce to 1 cup, strain, and let cool to room temperature.
remedies.dosage: Drink 1/2 cup twice daily before meals.
warnings: Keep well hydrated with warm water throughout the day.

remedies.title: Bala & Ashwagandha Nourishing Tonic for Knee Weakness & Muscle Atrophy
remedies.description: A restorative Rasayana formula containing Country Mallow (Bala) and Ashwagandha to rebuild quadriceps muscle strength supporting the knee joint.
remedies.preparation:
1. Simmer Bala and Ashwagandha powders in milk with ghee for 5 minutes.
2. Serve warm.
remedies.dosage: Drink 1 cup warm daily after breakfast or dinner.
warnings: Avoid during acute fever or indigestion (Ama).

remedies.title: Eucalyptus & Camphor Liniment for Acute Knee Soreness & Spasms
remedies.description: A fast-acting cooling-warming herbal liniment that penetrates deep into sore knee tendons, easing acute muscle tightness and sports soreness.
benefits: Rapid pain relief for knee soreness
remedies.preparation:
1. Dissolve camphor in warm coconut oil.
2. Stir in eucalyptus oil drops.
3. Gently rub into knee joint with light upward strokes.
remedies.dosage: Apply 2-3 times daily as needed for pain.
warnings: External application only.
Keep away from eyes and broken skin.

remedies.title: Neem, Turmeric & Aloe Vera Face Lepa for Acne & Glowing Skin
remedies.description: A purifying herbal face mask (Lepa) that cools excess Pitta, detoxifies skin pores, clears blemishes, and restores natural radiance.
remedies.preparation:
1. Mix neem leaf powder and wild turmeric in a small bowl.
2. Add fresh aloe vera gel and rose water, stirring into a smooth paste.
3. Apply evenly to clean face, avoiding the eye area.
4. Leave on for 15-20 minutes until dry, then rinse with lukewarm water.
remedies.dosage: Apply 2-3 times a week for glowing skin.
warnings: Perform a patch test behind the ear prior to first application.
Avoid using on open cuts or active bleeding skin lesions.

remedies.title: Bhringraj, Amla & Coconut Oil Massage for Hair Loss & Scalp Strength
remedies.description: A classic Ayurvedic scalp treatment infused with "King of Hair" (Bhringraj) and Gooseberry (Amla) to stimulate follicles, reduce hair fall, and prevent early graying.
ingredients: Pure Coconut Oil or Sesame Oil - 1/2 cup
remedies.preparation:
1. Warm coconut oil in a small pan on low heat.
2. Add Bhringraj powder, Amla powder, and fresh curry leaves.
3. Simmer gently for 8-10 minutes until oil darkens slightly.
4. Strain the oil into a glass jar and let cool until lukewarm.
5. Gently massage into scalp in circular motions for 10 minutes.
remedies.dosage: Apply to scalp twice weekly, leave for 1 hour or overnight before washing.
warnings: Ensure oil is lukewarm, not hot, before scalp massage.
Rinse thoroughly with mild natural shampoo.

remedies.title: Chyawanprash & Golden Warm Milk for Daily Vitality & Ojas
remedies.description: A time-honored daily Ayurvedic Rasayana ritual that nourishes all seven tissue layers (Dhatus), builds core energy (Ojas), and protects daily immunity.
ingredients: Warm Cow Milk or Almond Milk - 1 cup
remedies.preparation:
1. Warm a cup of milk gently on the stove with a pinch of cardamom.
2. Consume 1 tablespoon of Chyawanprash slowly on an empty stomach.
3. Sip the warm milk immediately after to enhance absorption into tissues.
remedies.dosage: Take 1 tablespoon every morning after waking up.
warnings: Diabetic individuals should select sugar-free Chyawanprash formulation.
Avoid taking milk immediately after acidic fruit juices.

remedies.title: Triphala Water Bedtime Tonic for Daily Detox & Longevity
remedies.description: The foundational 3-fruit rejuvenation blend (Amalaki, Bibhitaki, Haritaki) taken every night to cleanse the digestive tract, brighten vision, and promote longevity.
benefits: Balances all 3 Vata, Pitta & Kapha doshas
remedies.preparation:
1. Stir 1/2 teaspoon of Triphala powder into 1 cup of warm water.
2. Let it infuse for 5 minutes.
3. Add a dash of honey if desired once lukewarm, and sip slowly.
remedies.dosage: Drink 1 cup every night 30 minutes before sleep.
warnings: Reduce dosage if loose stools occur.
Do not consume during pregnancy without consulting your physician.
